editorial: Picture yourself stepping into a world where forgotten imagination takes form. In this family friendly fantasy, the lead’s knack for spotting imaginary companions turns the ordinary scene of a town into a playground of memory. The most vivid spectacle is a midnight rally of paper doll allies marching through an abandoned street, their translucent silhouettes pulsing with color. You’ll find it especially resonant if nostalgia is your favorite soundtrack. Though the pacing slows after the initial burst, the heartwarming climax more than makes up for the lag.
targetAudience: Ideal for family nights where imagination and warmth overrule plot.
